# Wilted flower: the stem bends over at mid height, the dark head hangs face down towards the front.
# Origin at the stem's foot. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Petal --base-color 0.6706 0.1216 0.3961 --no-slot
material new Centre --base-color 1.0000 0.5059 0.2588 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.2000 0.4078 0.8627 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Centre --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location 0.000 0.260 -0.05
scale 1.0 0.6 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 90.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location -0.247 0.080 -0.05
scale 1.0 0.6 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 162.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location -0.153 -0.210 -0.05
scale 1.0 0.6 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 234.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location 0.153 -0.210 -0.05
scale 1.0 0.6 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 306.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.18 --location 0.247 0.080 -0.05
scale 1.0 0.6 0.3
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 378.0
apply --rotation
select Pt0 Pt1 Pt2 Pt3 Pt4
active Pt0
join
rename Pt0 Petals
material assign Petal
select Centre
material assign Centre
select Petals Centre
active Centre
join
rename Centre Head
set rotation 130 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0 -0.42 0.48
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name Low --vertices 6 --radius 0.07 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
add mesh cylinder --name Up --vertices 6 --radius 0.065 --depth 0.42 --location 0 -0.16 0.62 --rotation -60 0 0
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name Leaf --size 1 --location 0.18 0 0.18
scale 0.32 0.14 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 50 0
select Low Up Leaf
active Low
join
rename Low Stem
material assign Stem
select Head Stem
active Stem
join
rename Stem Wilt
shade flat
export wilt.glb
